units.name: Departamento de Administração da Produção e Operações
units.school: Escola de Administração de Empresas de São Paulo
units.evidence: Official full departmental inventory explicitly names Department of Production and Operations Administration within EAESP; relevant academic doctoral line focuses on operations management/strategy, performance, competitiveness and sustainability.

decisions.reason: Imported school/Operations label reconciled to full official EAESP school and current Production and Operations Administration department within named FGV parent.

sources.note: Official school page expands EAESP as Escola de Administração de Empresas de São Paulo da Fundação Getulio Vargas and explicitly enumerates Departamento de Administração da Produção e Operações among teaching departments.

Full current academic doctorate and six mandatory research-line choices read, including Gestão de Operações e Sustentabilidade. Expanded Certificação Emitida explicitly awards Doutor(a) em Administração de Empresas; page describes scientific researcher training, advisor/research line and doctoral theses. Academic CDAE is separate from professional doctorate, not translated to DBA.

limitations: FGV parent and EAESP school relationship explicit; other FGV schools and technical/mathematical doctoral offerings not yet checked. Programme specialization and department are distinct organizational concepts; no unsupported exclusive host relationship assigned.
